<action type="say">
Here’s how to see your checking balance in the Bank of America mobile app:

1. Open the Bank of America app and sign in.
2. On the Home screen, you’ll see a list of your accounts. Look for the one labeled “Checking”.
3. On that “Checking” row, your balance is shown on the right side. That’s usually your available balance.
4. Tap on “Checking” to open it.
5. At the top of the screen you’ll see:
   - Available Balance (what you can use right now)
   - Sometimes Current/Posted Balance (after all cleared transactions)

If you tell me what you see next to “Checking” on that home screen, I can help you interpret it or walk through any recent transactions you’re unsure about.</action>
